svg.text: Initializer pipeline — how the initial feature set is created before MCTS search begins
— LLM parametric knowledge only, no data
Output: ~10 feature ideas from LLM knowledge — trial_phase, enrollment_count, sponsor_type, num_endpoints, ...
— TrialBench labels + RAG explain WHY trials succeed or fail
Look up trial → search PubMed + NCT
LLM converts 6 trial analyses into generalizable feature proposals
— LLM merges zero-shot + factor-based ideas into non-overlapping set
~10 unique, deduplicated feature definitions ready for planning
— LLM creates a structured FeaturePlan for each feature
instructions: "Look up phase from protocol section..."
— For EVERY trial: LLM extracts values per feature plan via RAG
LinearRAG: CTG + PubMed + ChEMBL + FAERS + AACT + PrimeKG + Drugs@FDA
Repeated for every trial — cached with diskcache to avoid redundant LLM calls
CTRA — Clinical Trial Risk Assessment | Feature Generation Pipeline (Initial)
Steps 1-7 run once at MCTS root node (iteration 0)
